entities.summary: The Aichi Loop Line  is a Japanese railway line connecting Okazaki Station in Okazaki and Kōzōji Station in Kasugai. It is the sole line operated by the third-sector Aichi Loop Railway . The line and operating company are both abbreviated as Aikan (愛環).
